description: Source code for an OPAE file creation wizard in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including classes for handling payment lines, generating control sectors, and assembling the final OPAE file in base64 encoding.

classes.name: OPAELine
classes.description: Represents a line in the OPAE file, with methods for setting data, generating control sectors, and formatting output.

classes.name: OPAE
classes.description: Represents the entire OPAE file, manages lines, headers, footers, and file assembly.

methods.name: get_date
methods.description: Returns the formatted date for an OPAE line based on payment and line data.

methods.name: set_communication
methods.description: Splits a communication string into 4 blocks of 35 characters for the OPAE line.

methods.name: set_address
methods.description: Sets address fields in the OPAE line from provided address objects.

methods.name: _create_control_sector
methods.description: Creates the control sector string for an OPAE line.

methods.name: _format_post_account
methods.description: Formats a postal account number into the required string format.

methods.name: escape_vals
methods.description: Normalizes and encodes string values to ASCII for OPAE line fields.

methods.name: _generate_dest_bank_string
methods.description: Generates the destination bank string based on transaction type and account info.

methods.name: generate_string
methods.description: Generates the full string representation of an OPAE line.

methods.name: get_lines_order_num
methods.description: Returns the next available order number for a line based on date and currency.

methods.name: create_opae_footer
methods.description: Creates the footer string for the entire OPAE file.

methods.name: parse_payment_lines
methods.description: Parses payment order lines to generate corresponding OPAE lines.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Assembles the complete OPAE file as a base64-encoded string.
